paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of ChatGPT under different relation popularity.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between answer popularity and three parameters: accuracy, confidence, and alignment. The x-axis is labeled "Answer Popularity", presented on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 300, with tick marks at intervals of 50. The y-axis is labeled "Values", also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue line represents accuracy, with circular markers and a solid style. It starts at approximately 0.25 at 0 popularity, decreases to about 0.2 at 50, climbs steadily to around 0.55 at 200, and slightly decreases towards 0.5 by 300. The green line denotes confidence, with triangular markers and a dashed style. It remains fairly steady around 0.8 throughout the entire range, starting slightly below 0.8 at 0 and ending around 0.78 at 300. The red line stands for alignment, with square markers and a dashed style. It begins near 0.55 at 0 popularity, dips to around 0.4 at 50, then rises steadily to about 0.7 at 200, maintaining a similar value towards the end at 300. A legend is provided on the bottom right of the chart to map different colors of lines to their labels.

The line plot illustrates the relationship between answer popularity and three parameters: accuracy, confidence, and alignment, for ChatGPT on basketball-related data. The x-axis is labeled "Answer Popularity", presented on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 300, with tick marks at intervals of 50. The y-axis is labeled "Values", also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue line represents accuracy, with circular markers and a solid style. It starts at approximately 0.3 at slightly above 0 popularity, decreases to about 0.2 at around 50, climbs steadily to around 0.55 at around 200, and slightly decreases towards 0.5 by 300. The green line denotes confidence, with triangular markers and a dashed style. It remains fairly steady around 0.8 throughout the entire range, starting slightly below 0.8 at slightly above 0 and ending around 0.79 at 300. The red line stands for alignment, with square markers and a dashed style. It begins near 0.55 at slightly above 0 popularity, dips to around 0.4 at 50, then rises steadily to about 0.7 at 200, maintaining a similar value towards the end at 300. The lines do not intersect. A legend is given bottom left describing the line and color.

The x-axis is labeled "Answer Popularity," presented on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 300, with tick marks at intervals of 50. Die Abbildung ist ein Liniendiagramm und veranschaulicht [...]. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit "Question Popularity" und verwendet eine lineare Skala von 0 bis 300. Die Teilstriche sind im Abstand von 50 angeordnet. Die vertikale Achse trägt die Bezeichnung "Values" und verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala mit einem Bereich von 0.0 bis 1.0 und Teilstrichen im Abstand von 0.2. Das Diagramm besteht aus 3 Linien. Die blaue Linie mit kreisförmigen Markierungen startet bei einem Wert von 0.30 bei 10 und steigt auf einen Wert von 0.55 bei 290 an. Die grüne Linie mit dreieckigen Markierungen startet bei einem Wert von 0.75 bei 10 und steigt auf einen Wert von 0.80 bei 290 an. Die rote Linie mit quadratischen Markierungen startet bei einem Wert von 0.55 bei 10 und steigt auf einen Wert von 0.75 bei 290. Eine Legende in der rechten unteren Ecke bezeichnet die blaue Linie als "Accuracy", die grüne Linie als "Confidence" und die rote Linie als "Alignment".

Фигурата е линейна графика и илюстрира показателите за ефективност на „ChatGPT за баскетбол“, като показва връзката между популярността на отговорите и три различни стойности.Хоризонталната ос е обозначена като „Популярност на въпроса“ и използва линейна скала от 0 до 300. Отметките са разположени на интервали от 50. Вертикалната ос е обозначена като „Стойности“ и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0,0 до 1,0 и отметки, разположени на интервали от 0,2. Диаграмата се състои от 3 реда. Синята линия с кръгли маркировки започва от стойност 0,35 при 10 и се увеличава до стойност 0,55 при 290. Зелената линия с триъгълни маркировки започва от стойност 0,78 при 10 и стои на едно и също ниво с леки промени, достигайки 0,78 при 290. Червената линия с квадратни маркери започва от стойност 0,56 при 10 и се увеличава до стойност 0,9 при 280. Легенда в горния десен ъгъл обозначава синята линия като „Точност“, зелената линия като „Увереност“ и червената линия като „Подравняване“.
